title: Firework Flourish
desc: Fireworks for any SwiftUI view, continuous or one-shot, with built-in styles and palettes.
long: Fireworks for any view. Rockets rise, flash and burst into twinkling particles that fade out, over a card, a button, a calendar cell or a whole screen. Run it continuously while a view is on screen, or play it once when something happens: a goal, an achievement, a level up, a countdown reaching zero. Thirteen presets and nine palettes cover everything from a quiet sparkle to a full finale, and every knob is a parameter. Nothing is stored between frames, so an idle layer costs nothing.
params: A preset (card, subtle, milestone, grand, tap, romance, neonPop, embers, sparkle, pastelBloom, newYear, like, frost) or your own FireworkStyle.
Continuous layer only. False fades it out and pauses the timeline, so it costs nothing.
One-shot modifier. Change the trigger to play the fireworks once, for duration seconds.
Seconds between rockets and particles per burst.
Burst spread in points and downward drift. Negative gravity makes embers rise.
Rise time, glow time and how long the particles take to fade.
Where bursts happen, as a fraction of the width and height.
Pairs of colors a burst blends between. Nine ready-made palettes.
Set it on a light surface: normal blending and deeper colors.
steps: 1. Add the package in Xcode (File, Add Package Dependencies) or in Package.swift
2. Add the FireworkFlourish product to your target, then import it
